Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Class BadgeDef

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.views.BadgeDef
public final class BadgeDef extends Object
A count badge in the page contract, fed by a JSON endpoint and polled by juneau-badges.js.

The endpoint returns {total, mine?, items?[]}. The badge is presentation only: the endpoint must still authorize the caller, and a page should not declare a badge for users who cannot read it.

Example:

var badge = BadgeDef .create("pending") .src("/rest/changes/pending") .scope("beanType", BadgeDef.ScopeBy.NAV, Map.of("suspensions", List.of("Suspension"))) .href("/ui/changes") .stateFilter("beanType") .refreshes("rules-table") .refreshMs(60_000); badge.validate(); // throws IllegalArgumentException with an E-6x message

Since:
10.0.0

    • refreshes

      public BadgeDef refreshes(String... value)
      Sets the card ids to JuneauViews.tables.reload(el, {resetPaging: false}) when a previously-seen item id drains from the badge's response.

      Every id here must name a card on the page being rendered, unless it is also listed in refreshesAllowMissing(String...).

      Parameters:
      value - The card ids, in reload order.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • refreshesAllowMissing

      public BadgeDef refreshesAllowMissing(String... value)
      Sets card ids, added to refreshes, that are allowed to be absent from the page being rendered.

      A page normally rejects a refreshes id that names no card on it, which catches typos at build time. Use this for a header badge that refreshes a card living on another page: the client skips a card that is not mounted. The ids named here are exempt from that check; every id passed to refreshes stays strict. The name follows the refreshes / stateFilter noun style of this builder: the opt-in is per id, not a page-wide switch.

      Parameters:
      value - The card ids that may live on another page.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • validate

      public void validate()
      Validates this definition.

      Enforces E-61 (no src), a same-origin src and href, E-62 (refreshMs below MIN_REFRESH_MS), E-66 (BadgeDef.Placement.TOOLBAR without table), and the view-scope rule (uncoded: BadgeDef.ScopeBy.VIEW without table). The "table/refreshes name a real card id" rule and the "scope.values key is a real nav node id" need the rest of the page and run in PageCapture at </@console> instead.

      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If this definition is not well-formed.
